caption: The drawing depicts an arrangement of flowers and leaves on a neutral, light-colored background. At the center left, there is a prominent, dark blue flower with five petals and a yellow center. Above this flower, there are several pink flower buds and smaller blooms attached to green stems. To the right, a large flower with overlapping petals shaded in light pink, dark pink, and red is shown. Below the red and pink flower, there is another flower featuring petals outlined in dark blue, with internal shadings of white, pink, and blue. Near the blue flower, there is a small vase or pitcher outlined in blue, decorated with a lattice pattern. Additional green leaves and stems connect the flowers and buds, with some leaves displaying a mix of green, red, and blue hues. The objects are embroidered with visible stitching, and the composition is centered on the fabric, with ample blank space around the floral arrangement.
title: Bed Hanging (Detail)
